mapper.insert: INSERT INTO memory_sources (memory_id,user_id,source_type,source_id,active,created_at) VALUES (#{memoryId},#{userId},#{sourceType},#{sourceId},#{active},#{createdAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE active=VALUES(active)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM memory_sources WHERE memory_id=#{memoryId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND active=1

SELECT s.source_type, s.source_id, c.checkin_date, m.conversation_id FROM memory_sources s LEFT JOIN checkins c ON s.source_type='checkin' AND c.id=s.source_id AND c.user_id=s.user_id LEFT JOIN conversation_messages m ON s.source_type='conversation_message' AND m.id=s.source_id AND m.user_id=s.user_id AND m.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN conversations v ON v.id=m.conversation_id AND v.user_id=s.user_id AND v.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE s.memory_id=#{memoryId} AND s.user_id=#{userId} AND s.active=1 AND ((s.source_type='checkin' AND c.id IS NOT NULL) OR (s.source_type='conversation_message' AND v.id IS NOT NULL)) ORDER BY s.created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM memory_sources WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND source_type=#{sourceType} AND source_id=#{sourceId} AND active=1
mapper.update: UPDATE memory_sources SET active=0 WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND source_type=#{sourceType} AND source_id=#{sourceId} AND active=1
